snippet.title: NITRO GEN OMEGA Launch Trailer | Anime Mecha RPG
snippet.description:
OUT NOW on PC, PS5, Xbox & Nintendo Switch - https://nitrogenomega.com

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2525510/NITRO_GEN_OMEGA/

----
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/nitro-gen-omega-switch/

A sandbox tactical RPG of steel, fire, friendship, and shonen anime. Assemble your crew, customize your Mech, and lead them in cinematic turn-based battles through a world ruled by rogue AI. The bonds you forge will decide who survives!
